Questions

Common questions before a first visit.

The booking form also lets you describe symptoms or goals so the team can prepare before you arrive.

Do you accept dental emergencies?

Yes. Call the clinic and we will triage pain, swelling, broken teeth or lost restorations for the earliest available appointment.

Can I get a treatment estimate first?

Yes. After the exam and diagnostics, we explain options, timing and fees before any non-urgent care begins.

Do clear aligners hurt?

Most patients feel pressure for a day or two when trays change. We track fit and comfort at scheduled check-ins.

Are whitening and veneers safe for enamel?

We recommend whitening or veneers only after checking gums, enamel, bite and sensitivity risk. Minimal tooth preparation is always preferred.

Ready for a cleaner, healthier smile?

New patients, emergency appointments and cosmetic consultations are available by appointment.
